review: So, I feel this game have too much hype. I sat through the entire session expecting it to get better but it turns out that there is no moment of glory nor any engaging story. :(
I mean...the ending?  So much good work undone.
Forced myself to finish this with one playthrough 5 hours uninstall.
great great characters but the story so underwhelming and game is so clunky at times
Ending doesn't hit the same when you play the game like a schizoid (or if you are one like me)[spoiler]and are able to see her trying to manipulate you from the beginning.[/spoiler]
Beautiful but the ending left me feeling unfulfilled and confused
Buggy physics ruined the moment a couple times but otherwise great game

Not my usual kind of game but for £4 on sale I was very satisfied with this purchase.  The art style was gorgeous and although a short game, the relationship built up between the protagonist and deuteragonist definitely sparked up a mixture of emotions ranging from happy and excited to sad and even awkward. 

My biggest gripe with this game was that the ending was very anti-climatic.  I feel like even given a couple more hours of gameplay the dev's could have thought up of something to give a more satisfactory ending.  Just when the game starts getting really interesting..  It ends..

Beutiful game, sadly too short.

+ Graphics
+ Map
+ Story
- Too short :C

9/10
for the first game, D is stand for Delilah. but at the end of the game, D is stand for Disappointment.
